title: UN Experts Issue Formal Warning Over Escalating Israeli Settler Violence and Displacement Risk in Occupied Palestinian Territory
detail: UN human rights experts issued a formal warning on June 1, 2026 regarding escalating Israeli settler violence and the heightened risk of displacement in occupied Palestinian territory. The experts cited a pattern of intensifying attacks against Palestinian communities, describing the situation as a systematic effort to pressure Palestinians to leave their land. The warning called on the international community and Israel to take immediate steps to halt settler violence and protect Palestinian civilians under international humanitarian law.
